character:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original mascot illustration for NIGHTRIDERCO Kick profile and broadcast identity, transparent PNG
Primary request: design Skadi, the Norse winter huntress, as a memorable clean bold adult female mascot. She has a frost-silver hood framing her face, a composed confident slightly fierce expression, ice blue eyes, and a simple dark slate cloak. A subtle angular icy bow silhouette behind one shoulder suggests the huntress. Head and upper shoulders, front-facing, compact balanced emblem composition. Original character, no reference to any game or film depiction.
Style/medium: polished modern vector-friendly illustration, strong black/dark outlines, large flat graphic shapes, very restrained highlights, stylish Nordic sports broadcast identity. Beautiful dignified face, adult proportions, no sexualization.
Composition/framing: centered head-and-shoulders fills about 82 percent of square canvas; generous transparent margin; coherent closed silhouette; no enclosing shield or circle; readable when reduced to 128 pixels.
Color palette: deep blue-black #0B1118, slate #152330, frost silver #F1F6F8, icy cyan #74DFFF. Skin natural pale warm neutral.
Text: none.
Constraints: true transparent background outside mascot; no lettering, no wordmark, no runes, no horns, no fur animal head, no watermark; symmetrical silhouette with some human expression, crisp clean edges. Output square high resolution.
landscape:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 16:9 Nordic environmental background for NIGHTRIDERCO broadcast screens
Primary request: a clean cinematic night landscape of a Norwegian fjord, snow-cut angular mountains, near-black cold water, a restrained icy-cyan aurora ribbon high in the sky, and distant light silver mist. Geometric large silhouettes, refined editorial graphic texture, expansive quiet negative space especially across left half and central upper half for broadcast typography. No people or characters.
Style/medium: polished atmospheric digital illustration, exceptionally clean strong forms with subtle grain; luxury Nordic sports/technology identity. Not busy fantasy concept art.
Color palette: near black #0B1118, slate #152330, muted blue gray #95A8B5, frost #F1F6F8 used sparingly, icy cyan #74DFFF.
Composition: wide 16:9 cinematic frame, mountain ridges concentrated lower third and right edge, 60 percent dark quiet sky. Very low contrast left and center so white text will read.
Constraints: no text, no logos, no runes, no cars, no buildings, no UI, no watermark. Full-bleed opaque background.
